problemSection.headline: Great technology stalls on broken go-to-market

cards.title: No pipeline visibility on 12-month cycles
cards.description: Selling to utilities, grid operators, and OEMs means cycles of 12–18 months. Without a proper CRM and lifecycle enforcement, you don't know where deals stall or why they go cold.

cards.title: Tool jungle with no signal
cards.description: LinkedIn outreach from personal inboxes, a CRM nobody updates, cold email that burns your domain. You have the tools — you just don't have a system connecting them.

cards.title: Technical team, no commercial playbook
cards.description: You know how your technology works. No one on the team has built a repeatable outbound motion to procurement leads, sustainability directors, or engineering buyers at scale.

valueProposition.headline: Map. Deploy. Operate.
valueProposition.body:
Ryzo overlays an agent-led GTM system on your existing team. We map your ICP across the energy value chain — utilities, grid operators, EV manufacturers, industrial buyers — deploy the right outbound and inbound systems, and operate them as a managed service.

You don't hire a sales team. You don't buy more tools. You get a complete commercial motion that runs, learns your market, and compounds over time.

services.headline: The full commercial stack — without the headcount

cards.description: Paid acquisition on LinkedIn and Google targeting the right decision-makers in the energy transition. Creative strategy, media buying, and conversion tracking — without an agency retainer.

steps.title: GTM Audit
steps.description: We map your ICP across the energy value chain, review your current stack and outbound motion, and identify the highest-leverage pipeline gaps. Deliverable: written GTM blueprint in week two.

steps.title: System Design
steps.description: We design your agent-led GTM stack — which OS layers you need, which tools to replace or consolidate, and how to connect outbound, performance, and RevOps into one system.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.description: We build and launch your OutboundOS sequences, PerformanceOS campaigns, and RevOS configuration. You review the strategy; we operate the execution.

steps.title: Operate & Optimise
steps.description: Ongoing management, weekly pipeline reporting, and quarterly strategy reviews. The system compounds as it learns your market and the buying signals in your sector.

items.question: Do you work with cleantech and energy companies specifically?
items.answer: Yes. We've built GTM systems for B2B companies with long, complex sales cycles — including those selling to utilities, grid operators, and industrial buyers. The ICP research, sequencing, and CRM configuration are tailored to your specific buyer landscape.

items.question: Our sales cycle is 12–18 months. Can GTM automation actually help?
items.answer: Especially then. Long cycles don't mean slow starts — they mean you need more leads entering the top of the funnel consistently, better multi-stakeholder tracking, and clear pipeline visibility. OutboundOS and RevOS are built for exactly this.

items.question: We're a technical team — we don't have a sales or marketing function.
items.answer: That's exactly who Ryzo is built for. You provide market knowledge and approve strategy; we design and operate the commercial system. Most clients run a full GTM motion without hiring a single salesperson.

items.question: How is Ryzo different from hiring an agency?
items.answer: Agencies sell hours and deliverables. Ryzo deploys systems that run continuously. We replace your tool stack with agent-led infrastructure and operate it — so results compound instead of resetting every retainer cycle.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on which OS layers you need and your pipeline targets. Most clients invest €5k–€15k/month — typically less than their current disconnected tool stack. Book a demo and we'll scope it against your specific situation.

items.question: We're not based in the Netherlands — does that matter?
items.answer: Not at all. We work with B2B scale-ups across Europe. The GTM system, outbound sequences, and RevOps configuration are fully remote and language-adaptable.
